svg.title: QPX MuData structure
svg.desc: build_mudata gathers precursor and protein-group intensity matrices, and optional absolute and differential expression, into one MuData container with a precursor to protein-group map and dataset metadata. Grids are schematic. Null intensities are omitted from sparse matrices, whose implicit cells read as zero. Label-free data keep one observation per run or unit unless all_intensity_labels=True.
svg.text: Quantification matrices for mudata, muon and scanpy
build_mudata(ds) includes the available modalities. Colored grids are schematic, not measured data.
iTRAQ and plexDIA, with each run's sample
feature.pg_accessions, on the joint var axis.
Null intensities are omitted from the sparse matrices; implicit cells read as zero. Decoys are left out unless include_decoys=True.
Repeated cells are summed by default, or averaged with duplicates="mean". Multiplexed data expand to one observation per channel.
